text:
Elaine: Heads-up: MerchantSCV asking for a 3-week POC for invoice-extraction+assist. Need presales scope + eval harness. Can someone help? @samir
Samir: On it. Quick Qs: what are the success metrics? latency/throughput, extraction F1, UAT acceptance? Who owns data?
Elaine: Customer wants >=95% field-level extraction F1 on invoices, <200ms median token latency, and <2% hallucination on sensitive fields. Also privacy: they can't send raw PII to hosted. They want Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC.
Maria: Ok. For eval harness we should create golden set of 300 invoices (diverse vendors, multi-page, noisy scans). Seed set: 50 anchor goldens for nightly regression. Scoring: field-level F1 + normalized Levenshtein for free-text fields. Proposed pass: F1>=0.95 and regression drift <=1.5% on anchors.
Samir: Recommend model variants: redwood-bert-xxl-q4 -> candidate; fallback to smaller quantized for cost. Autoscaling config? propose baseline qps 4 per GPU.
Elaine: Pricing ask: they asked for pilot pricing for 3 weeks — how to structure? they'd prefer capped spend. Any template?
Maria: We usually offer 'trial credit + committed pilot cap' — propose $15k cap with option to convert to monthly Dedicated. I can draft SOW. Also need security questionnaire: they sent a SOC2-lite + data flow diagram.
legal-qa: Re: security: we can support Dedicated + VPC. Need customer to sign DPA and provide network allowlist. Also flag: they require HSM-backed key management — confirm with infra team.
Samir: For eval harness CI: set up GitHub Actions running evals nightly against anchors. Use deterministic prompts and seed RNG. Use metrics: F1, exact-match, hallucination-rate. Export CSV to S3 (or internal staging) and share dashboard.
Maria: I'll draft prompt templates: extraction YAML with field definitions, normalization rules, and scoring SQL. Also will provide sample curl for running batch eval:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/eval \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"batch_s3":"s3://staging/scv/goldens/*.json","template":"invoices/extract_v2.yaml"}'
```
Elaine: Awesome. Can we get a 2-day turnaround on golden set prep & security checklist by EOD Wed? Customer meeting Fri.
Maria: Yes. I'll upload seed set to staging and share link. pinging @presales-bot to create pilot workspace.
presales-bot: Pilot workspace created: scv-merchant-pilot-2187. API key provisioned (rotating). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/pilots/scv-merchant-pilot-2187
Elaine: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and send SOW draft.
